verdict.rationale: dlt ships an official CLI documented at dlthub.com/docs/reference/command-line-interface for creating, adding, inspecting, and deploying pipelines, plus a `dlthub deploy` command and dltHub CLI for monitoring — corroborated by a standalone probe confirming the docs page exists. This is explicitly framed as usable by AI-native workflows (coding agents, AI Harness) alongside the CLI. Missing for 10: independent hands-on review of the CLI itself (not just docs) and clearer detail on CLI command coverage/versioning.
